outcome: infant health (Apgar scores, physical examination, lung ventilation, heart sounds)
cohort: A single 44-year-old pregnant woman at 32 weeks gestation diagnosed with COVID-19 and her newborn.
finding: A 44-year-old COVID-19 infected pregnant woman delivered a healthy preterm baby with no evidence of vertical COVID-19 transmission or other adverse clinical outcomes for the mother or baby at birth.
